banner_admin_ok_hint: All registry branches are available, including the system branch HKU\.DEFAULT — removal will be complete.
banner_admin_no_hint: Without admin rights only the current user's profile will be cleaned: the system branch HKU\.DEFAULT will remain, and Windows may restore the layout after a reboot. For complete removal click “🔑 Restart as Administrator” and confirm the UAC prompt.

hint_welcome_details: After you pick a layout, a map of all scanned branches with detection status will appear here.
